payload.reason: The evidence provides information about a new system that outperforms existing state-of-the-art systems in Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) using BERT-based models.

claims.text: The proposed system achieves new state-of-the-art results on the WSD task by leveraging gloss information and fine-tuning a pre-trained BERT model.
The experimental results show that the new approach significantly outperforms previous methods in WSD benchmarks.
The system is evaluated on several English all-words WSD benchmark datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness.
